title: The Twin Voids Canon
summary: A canon of paired voids that seal and unmake in turns and end in the erasure of what stands between them.

title: Treatise of Paired Absence and the Stilled Current
summary: A treatise on emptying a current of qi until it runs dry and drags what stands in its bed down into the gap.

title: The Hawk Void Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of void moves that watch from far above and drop unseen onto the one chosen.

title: The Windward Silence Canon
summary: A canon of silence set against the wind that stills every gust and every shout and holds its ground to the last.

title: Treatise of the Oath-Anchored Void
summary: A treatise on swearing the self to an empty anchor and loosing the sworn nothing on the oath-breaker.

title: Canon of the Unwalled Emptiness
summary: A canon of an emptiness with no wall and no edge that opens across the open field and draws all strength into it.
